title: CNK-FarmaStatR: a reproducible platform for pharmaceutical statistics in education and research
description: Research and education platform for pharmaceutical statistics: in vitro population bioequivalence (FDA PSG 020929) with simulation-based design selection, f2 and bootstrap f2, model-independent and Weibull multivariate statistical distance for dissolution profiles. Validated R cores run in the browser (webR). Not a system validated for GxP environments. DRAFT prepared in P6 (FSR-TN-PLT-06); the license (open item A-6) is added before the first release.
